newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Army helicopter crashes, five killed.
newsitem.headline: Thai Army helicopter crashes, five killed.

text.p: A Thai army helicopter crashed during a training mission in southern Thailand on Friday, killing five people and injuring two, an army officer said.
The helicopter had engine problems and crashed in Songkhla province, about 1,275 km (765 miles) south of Bangkok, the officer told Reuters from Songkhla.
He did not have further details, but said the pilot and the engineer were among the dead. There were seven people on board when it crashed.
